snippet.title: Painted Kingdoms Pégases Trailer
snippet.description:
Painted Kingdoms is a minimalist strategy game where you build, paint, and defend your Kingdom of paper. Harness the power of water to protect it from relentless flames and enemy hordes. Will your Painted Kingdom survive the next wave?

The free demo is out now on Steam 👇 Play and Wishlist Painted Kingdoms Now !!!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3596730?utm_source=org&utm_medium=youtube
